**Field arrays**
- `results/field_samples.npy`: (8, 24) **float32**, finite, values in [−8.19, 40.19] kcal/mol/e — assembly reaction field (medium − vacuum) trilinearly interpolated at the 24 queries per case.

Pixel-verified: title text, 8 diverging-colormap slice panels + shared colorbar, grouped 3-color bars (primary/secondary/gap) with legend.

**Numerics / solver log**
- 24 linear solves (medium linearized + all vacuum subtractions): conjugate gradients at rtol 1e-12 (direct SuperLU fallback never triggered); verified residual 5.8e-10 on case_000 assembly.
- 18 nonlinear (sinh-screening) solves: damped Newton with κ-continuation (6 stages, backtracking on residual) — **all 18 converged with Newton, no fixed-point fallback needed**. Independent re-solve of case_004 assembly: full-κ residual 8.2e-13 (tol ≈ 5.8e-5).
- Per your notes: each entity uses its own rows for surface + CIC deposition (CYS CB/HG split in 002/003 handled — assembly ≠ parts there); CIC divides by s³ so RHS = 4π·332.06371·Q; 6.5 Å gate on nearest part_b site counting all sites (charged or not); field outputs are the assembly reaction field in float32; case order = manifest order.
- Physics sanity: eps_in=12 cases (006/007) give much smaller primary responses (~492/504 vs ~3500 for 004/005) as expected; secondary cross-terms are small (1.6–22 kcal/mol) since only the ≤6.5 Å interaction shell is summed.

**Limitations / interpretations kept as agreed in plan**
- tanh smoothing `sf = 0.5(1+tanh(SDF/window))`; nonlinear term `κ²·sf·sinh(φ/RT)` with φ_B = R·T (R = 1.9872042586); sharp sf = 1 where SDF > 0.
- Assembly field geometry: volume_b when probe>0/smol, volume_a otherwise (identical at probe 0; reconstruction matches provided tensors to ≤1.2e-5).
- CG tolerance 1e-12 vs a direct solve: energy impact ≪ 1e-3 kcal/mol.
- Runtime ~8.5 min CPU (dominated by ~900-iteration CG solves and Newton factor-free iterations); deterministic.
